label: Text 1
transcript: Sam stands in the corridor of the new building. Klasse 6 has a different floor. The lockers click shut. The chemistry lab smells faintly of vinegar. Lina finds Sam staring at a noticeboard. "Same class, different planet," she says. Mr. Flint walks past with a tray of test tubes, says, "Welcome back," and disappears into the lab without slowing down. Klasse 6 has begun, and the building has agreed to it.
